purpose: Standing tripwire data for entry 31's calibrated falsifier (Smolin cosmological natural selection). Entry 31 predicts NO securely-measured neutron star above 2.5 Msun (Smolin's bar); it is REFUTED by a CONFIRMED, securely-measured, method-agnostic NS mass whose CENTRAL value >= the bar. b68_entry31_massbar_tripwire.py recomputes the verdict from this ledger on every battery run. This is RQ-E of the BHU Lane 2 plan (Duho: 'E always-on'), the mass-bar twin of the b63 curvature watcher.
convention: Firing is on the CENTRAL value crossing the bar, not the error bar touching it -- per the corrected method-agnostic reading (Smolin footnote 5: other methods yield less precise estimates, NOT excluded by instrument). A measurement counts only if secure=true. Gravitational-wave secondaries of unresolved NS-vs-BH nature are tracked as secure=false ('conditional') and do NOT fire the tripwire.
regate_note: Unlike the curvature watcher there is no sub-threshold hint band: a secure central mass >= 2.5 IS the refutation, so the tripwire FAILS the battery the moment such a row is added, forcing a fresh two-seat gate + a Duho tier/status decision (MUST-STOP). Below the bar it PASSES and reports the gap (bar - max_secure_central) in sigma for drift monitoring.
drift_note: At 2.35 +/- 0.11 the falsifier is 1.36 sigma short and moving AWAY as errors tighten: firing requires the CENTRAL value to move up, not the error to shrink (tightening at fixed central drives the bar further in sigma).
how_to_update: When a new NS mass measurement lands (arXiv / ATNF pulsar catalogue), add {source, object, mass_msun, sigma, method, secure, note} and re-run the battery. If the tripwire FAILS, run a fresh two-seat gate and bring it to Duho. Do NOT edit the bar, flip a secure flag, or delete a row to make it pass. Poll cadence: opportunistic on ticks + rides the existing weekly cron rails.
